data.one_liner: A collection of customizable Flutter widgets designed for rapid UI development.
data.what_it_does: Widgetly provides ready-to-use UI components such as app bars, buttons, pickers, and text fields with consistent styling and behavior. It supports global configuration for colors, font family, and locale.
use_when: You want to build standard UI layouts quickly using pre-made components.
You need consistent styling and behavior across common widgets like buttons and text fields.
avoid_when: Your project relies on standard `package:flutter/material.dart` and you do not want to adopt `material_ui`.
You require highly custom or bespoke UI designs that do not fit predefined component kits.
strengths: Includes a rich variety of ready-to-use widgets with consistent styling.
Global configuration for colors, fonts, and locales simplifies theme maintenance.
weaknesses: Requires migration to standalone `material_ui` and `cupertino_ui` packages.
Ties your app's base UI components to a specific third-party library structure.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter >= 3.47 and Dart >= 3.13, and replacement of standard material imports with `material_ui`.
data.minimal_example:
ButtonLy(
  label: 'SUBMIT',
  mainColor: Colors.blue,
  onTap: () => handleSubmit(),
  showOutline: true,
  isLoading: false,
  icon: Icons.send,
)
